items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: we had Laura Watson as one singer and Lady Day the other

ctx.x: And, uh, and then - Pete Brown was the regular band in the club; we were the trio, and then we had Laura Watson as one singer and Lady Day the other -- talk about two good singers and we had a little floor show with a comedian and the whole thing; it was a lovely club--- now, all this is happening to me now, you see, I'm working all over hell--- in Chicago.
